decisions: Slot picks, one per slot (research selection only; design decisions stay with design-director): Layout=airborne-studio, Type=noth, Motion=elu-dev, Components=planetscale-benchmarks (NEW), Conversion=meinhard-taxer.

files_created: brain/resources.json (appended planetscale-benchmarks, samwho-dev; annotated elu-dev notes)
risks: All selected references are NEW or REVIEWED; none is APPROVED/TRUSTED. AGENTS.md section 7 uses APPROVED/TRUSTED by default, so the user should confirm them at G1.
elu-dev is currently a product marketing site (Elu, 'Make your software improve itself'), not a developer portfolio, so its brain best_for may be stale. The brain notes are updated.
A 1vw root font (noth) needs a floor/clamp and a WCAG 1.4.4 resize check; noth itself resets to 16px below 992px.
An odometer or large-numeral treatment (elu) is only honest with sourced numbers. Three resume numbers are unsourced (CONTENT_SOURCE section 6 item 8).
A mailto marquee (meinhard) needs reduced-motion pause and aria-hidden duplicates. The owner email is still unconfirmed (PRODUCT open question 1).
The meinhard closing marquee could not be screenshotted (a covered reveal under Lenis). Its numbers come from computed styles only.
k95 and bruno-simon-style WebGL conflict with LCP < 2.5s and mobile Lighthouse >= 90; they are kept only as alternates.
open_questions: Does the owner admire any specific engineer portfolios? If so, a peer pass can measure them.
Should samwho-dev replace or supplement planetscale-benchmarks for case-study body pages? That is design-director's call.
next_instructions: Read INSPIRATION.md for the five slots, then REFERENCE_BREAKDOWN.md for the measured numbers (grid, scale, easing, durations). Use these as mechanism options only; never copy assets, fonts or copy.

Evidence mechanisms to consider across directions: a methodology-first result block (planetscale), a mono label over a large accessible numeral (elu), and dash-pattern series with inline legend tokens (samwho alternate).
Keep each Design Council fork isolated. Each fork may draw on any slot; the critic sees all three.
